page.content:
Alfrida of the Yale was a hobbit of the Shire. Presumably from the Yale, she at some point married Gundolpho Bolger, to whom she bore Gundahar, Rudolph, and Gundahad. Nothing further of her life is known.

page.overview:
Who is Alfrida of the Yale?

Alfrida of the Yale was a hobbit of the Shire. Presumably from the Yale, she at some point married Gundolpho Bolger, to whom she bore Gundahar, Rudolph, and Gundahad. Nothing further of her life is known.
